analysis: The PR changes only CHANGELOG.md. It adds one line at head line 5: new Autopilot daily earnings floor accrual ends after November 7, 2026 UTC for every machine. November 7 settles at midnight November 8, and pending rewards for earlier eligible days stay payable without resetting baselines or base rewards. No code, configuration, authorization, attestation, encryption, billing logic or schema file is in the diff. I checked the added text against the changelog's other Autopilot entries (the floor, baseline repair and funding-pool entries at base lines 5-7). It does not contradict them: payments stay default-off, finalized receipts and baselines are untouched, and the separately funded pool and its cap are unchanged. It does not touch the TB-002 or TB-009 trust-boundary definitions, and no threat assumption is invalidated. Any real cutoff logic, such as UTC boundary handling, pending-day payout or double-payment prevention, would live in unreviewed coordinator code outside this PR. The text change alone gives no security-relevant evidence. If a companion code PR implements the cutoff, review it for settlement idempotency and boundary correctness against A-009 (payment ledger). No findings.
